primary_hypothesis: Private interaction frames with shared encoder improve quality over both competent singles and independent ensembles.

triage_rule.require_each_reference: Positive mean complete VALID MRR difference and higher score in at least2of3paired blocks
triage_rule.privacy_evidence: Positive mean complete VALID difference versus shared_frame_f4 and unframed_f4; otherwise no evidence for private frames beyond a common adapter
triage_rule.interpretation: Promotion to confirmation only; no statistical or novelty claim.

if_not_met: Preserve entire comparison and stop treating this exact candidate as a supported accuracy direction. Mechanism observations can motivate a separately frozen hypothesis, never rename the failed contrast as success.
confirmation_if_promoted: Prospectively fixed at least8fresh seed blocks on untouched TEST plus a second representative graph with competent same-operation controls and complete native recipes; review complete costs before admission. No original Collab TEST reuse as independent confirmation.
control_extension: New symmetric bilinear/tensor single is a stronger future interface control indicated by LowFER/NTN; it is not added to or used to change the current frozen screen.
compute_authorization: This decision admits no TEST evaluator or new fits. It requires separate representative source/resource/selection qualification before confirmation.
